faults.detail: "Run complete" is the end-of-run feedback line written wholly in English in a Hinglish piece (lang: "hinglish"); every other feedback string is Hinglish ("BILKUL SAHI", "WAHI JAGAH", "itna door").

notes: Truth checked: every wave's ticks equals its items' denominator (3,4,5,6,8) on a 0-1 line, so every item lands on a drawn mark; screens show 2 inner marks at 1/3 and 2/3 for wave 1. No title or sub names a mark. Subs such as "Barabar hisse gino" prompt the method (count the equal parts) without saying where an item goes; judged as an instruction, not a giveaway. Wave titles/subs are not visible on the first screen, so their on-screen layout could not be checked.
